officialReferenceCaveat: This dataset is a third-party, community-packaged copy of Indonesia administrative region data (cahyadsn/wilayah, MIT License), not an official Kementerian Dalam Negeri (Kemendagri) API or export. It should not be treated as a substitute for an operator's own official legal/compliance reference.
notes: Every sha256/bytes value here is verified against the real file on disk by tests/idn-admin-regions-vendor-manifest.test.ts, and every non-null decreeReference must appear verbatim in that file's own header — so a silently swapped dataset fails the build instead of being served as if it were this one.

decreeReference is recorded PER FILE, read from each file's own header, because upstream does not ship one decree for the whole dataset: db/wilayah.sql (the only file this module imports) cites Kepmendagri 300.2.2-2138/2025 while db/wilayah_pulau.sql cites 300.2.2-2430/2025. db/wilayah_penduduk.sql's header names no decree number at all, so it is null rather than guessed.

importedBy names the module whose code actually reads the file. Only db/wilayah.sql is read today; the other three are vendored from the SAME upstream commit so a future island/population/area feature does not have to guess which version matches the imported hierarchy.

Upstream db/ also contains wilayah_level_1_2.sql (a larger province/regency dataset with coordinates/elevation/timezone/boundaries) and an archive/ folder of superseded prior-year datasets. Neither is vendored; adding one is a deliberate new entry here, never an assumption that it is already present.
This is GLOBAL reference data, not tenant-scoped — see ADR-0046 and src/modules/idn-admin-regions/README.md.
